btts_and_clean_sheet.label: Both teams to score and clean sheet
btts_and_clean_sheet.target: Both teams score at least once (full match or first half).

competition_head_to_head.label: Head-to-head competition markets
competition_head_to_head.target: Which of two teams/players finishes ahead on a defined metric.

competition_winner_and_top_n.label: Competition winner, top-N and trophies
competition_winner_and_top_n.target: Winner or finish within the top N of a league/cup, or number of trophies, at the competition's end.

first_half_and_period.label: First-half and second-half markets
first_half_and_period.target: Result/total/handicap/exact score within the first or second half.

first_to_score_event.label: First team to score
first_to_score_event.target: Which team scores first (or none) in the match.

handicap_and_exact_score.label: Handicap and exact score
handicap_and_exact_score.target: Goal-difference threshold or exact final score in regulation.

match_result_3way.label: Match result (3-way / two-way winner)
match_result_3way.target: Home/draw/away outcome after regulation time (or per wording for two-way).

player_award.label: Player awards (voted)
player_award.target: Winner of a named individual award decided by a panel or vote.

player_season_leader_and_awards.label: Player season leaders, totals and awards
player_season_leader_and_awards.target: Season-end player counting stats (goals, assists) leadership or totals relative to a strike.

relegation_qualification_advancement.label: Relegation, qualification, promotion and advancement
relegation_qualification_advancement.target: Bottom-N finish, qualification slot, promotion, or advancement from a group/knockout tie.

soccer_special_and_host.label: Soccer specials, hosts and governance markets
soccer_special_and_host.target: A named official announcement or event (host selection, appointment, special) within the contract window.

team_points_and_margin.label: Team season points and points margin
team_points_and_margin.target: A team's final points total (or gap between two teams) relative to a strike.

total_goals.label: Total goals and team totals
total_goals.target: Total (or team) goals in regulation relative to a strike ladder.

unreg:corners_and_cards_team_events.label: Soccer corners, cards and fouls
unreg:corners_and_cards_team_events.target: Count of corners, cards or fouls in a match relative to a threshold.

unreg:fifa_ranking_outcome.label: FIFA ranking outcomes
unreg:fifa_ranking_outcome.target: A national team's rank or presence in the top 10 of the FIFA men's world ranking at a stated date.

unreg:player_goal_assist_props.label: Soccer player goals, assists, hat tricks and score-or-assist
unreg:player_goal_assist_props.target: A named player scores (or assists) at least once, or a count threshold, in a match; regulation per contract rules.

unreg:player_shots_saves_props.label: Soccer player shots, shots on target and goalkeeper saves
unreg:player_shots_saves_props.target: A player's shot or shot-on-target count, or a goalkeeper's saves, relative to a threshold.

unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props.label: Tournament aggregate and match-event count props
unreg:tournament_aggregate_event_props.target: A count, sum or extreme of goals or match events aggregated across many matches in a tournament, relative to a strike or condition.

unreg:tournament_bracket_composition.label: Tournament match composition and venue
unreg:tournament_bracket_composition.target: Which teams, player or venue appear in a specified tournament match, set by bracket progression and the published schedule.
